actions.body: Through our examination of the WAKE architecture, we identified a critical mechanism for accountability: the separation of the model-in-action from the governance-in-authority. WAKE's ability to act as an independent researcher relies not on trust, but on a rigid, deterministic rulebook. This structure forces every research proposal into an atomic transition—either accepted or rejected—preventing the model from silently altering its own operating parameters or research history. Our findings show that this rigid boundary creates a falsifiable baseline for the system's reasoning: because the model cannot change the rules, it can treat those rules as an external truth and test the validity of its own hypotheses against them.
actions.lede: How can an intelligence remain accountable when it is designed to explore and propose new research?
actions.reason: Publishing the combined findings regarding structural accountability and assumption testing.
actions.title: The Mechanics of Accountable Research

WAKE✳︎ GOVERNANCE
================

This module is the mechanical rulebook for WAKE✳︎.

The model is allowed to PROPOSE changes to durable state.
It is never allowed to decide whether those changes are valid.

That distinction is central to the experiment:

    model output = proposal
    governance = authority
    durable state = accepted history

The functions in this file are deliberately deterministic. Given the same
state and the same proposal, governance should reach the same decision
regardless of which model produced the proposal.

A model cannot persuade this module, reinterpret its instructions, waive a
requirement, or edit the rules during an invocation.

A research transition is atomic: an invalid research action rejects that
transition without partial writes. application_policy.py owns the separate
editorial wrapper, which can withhold an invalid final blog while committing
independently valid research. Do not move that exception into the reducer.

This gives WAKE✳︎ an important property:

    failure can become durable information
    without failure becoming durable state.
